microprocessor.name: Diesel
microprocessor.description: Diesel + 8-speed, motor assist, regen, touch cruise. Diesel from gear 3. Shift on engine RPS (up 12, down 7). Drive clutch off below idle 5. GB1 toward off 1:1 on 6:5, GB2 toward off 1:1 on 3:2, GB3 away off 3:1 on 1:1. 1st = ×0.33.

node.label: Seat
node.description: Seat data — W/S ch 2 (W throttle, S brake)

node.label: Clutch
node.description: Drive T→GB — slow launch, holds while moving, dips + cuts throttle on shift

node.label: Gearbox 3
node.description: Away from engine — off 3:1 (1st–4th), on 1:1. Reduction is OFF.

node.label: HUD
node.description: Tap speed to SET cruise. Left −5, right +5, middle cancel.

node.label: Motor
node.description: Starter, then pedal (no cut on shift)

node.label: Engine Clutch
node.description: Engine→T — 1 while cranking and from Diesel from gear

node.label: Physics
node.description: Physics sensor — spd ch 13, alt Y ch 2, hdg ch 17

node.label: Regen Clutch
node.description: T→generator — coast 1, idle on pedal; 0 at 100% battery

node.label: Shaft RPS
node.description: RPS sensor after the motor — shifts on this

node.label: Touch
node.description: Monitor composite. Tap speed to SET; − / + chips once on.
